title: Build a tenant activity feed
summary: Return the latest activity for one tenant with a bounded, deterministic query that uses the feed index.
objectives: Align a filtered, ordered, and limited query with an existing composite index.
Read an EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN result to confirm an index search.
Use a deterministic tie-breaker for rows with the same timestamp.
Keep a selective feed query from scanning the events table.
constraints: Return exactly the columns id, actor, kind, and occurred_at in that order.
Return only events for tenant_id 7 with occurred_at strictly before 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z.
Order rows by occurred_at descending, then by id descending.
The query plan must use the idx_events_tenant_occurred index and must not scan the events table.

examples.input: Tenant 7 has eight events before the cutoff
examples.output: The five newest rows, newest first
examples.explanation: The composite index covers the tenant, the time range, and the sort order.

examples.output: The row with the larger id comes first
examples.explanation: The id tie-breaker makes the feed order deterministic.

public.name: Latest tenant activity
public.description: The seeded feed returns the five newest events for tenant 7.

hidden.name: Cutoff boundary

hidden.name: Other tenants excluded
hidden.description: A busy second tenant must not appear in the feed.

hidden.name: Deterministic ties
hidden.description: Events sharing a timestamp are ordered by id descending.

hidden.name: Empty feed keeps the plan
